links.need: ODG must detect, isolate and recover from runtime/service faults within bounded attempts, preserving governance and observability — never silently escalating privileges or looping indefinitely.
links.requirement: On a detected fault: DETECT→ISOLATE→recover a BOUNDED number of attempts, then STOP (attempt-cap); a recovered service must return health 200; every attempt is recorded; failure never masked.
links.acceptance: Recovery attempts are attempt-capped (no infinite loop); recovered health==200 or an incident is recorded; CAP_EXCEEDED/RESTART_FAILED are logged honestly; rollback to a verified previous release is available.
links.evidence: incidents.jsonl recovery events (36 recover-class) + build-recovery-engine.test gate-wired + odg-recover attempt-cap (CAP_EXCEEDED present)
links.observation: ACTIVE_IN_PRODUCTION: incidents.jsonl shows real RECOVERED + rollback SWITCHED + honest RESTART_FAILED/CAP_EXCEEDED events (bounded recovery, failure never masked).
links.maintenance: post-release-learning + incident-recurrence + recovery-effectiveness capitalize recovery lessons; residual CRITICAL/HIGH risks (see P7-SRE FMEA) require owner acceptance.

honesty: observation = ACTIVE_IN_PRODUCTION backed by real incidents.jsonl events (not fixtures); every file reference RESOLVES; a broken reference would fail validation (tested).
